svg.title: Role Battle pending-change review fixes
svg.desc: Before and after diagram of enemy targeting, battle policy, civilian navigation, death dispatch, and validation fixes.
svg.text: Role/Battle pending-change review - corrected runtime boundaries
2026-08-24 | Enemy AI, battle zones, Civilian recovery, death deduplication, and executable verification
Before: pending implementation hazards
Enemy targeting
Snapshots named the hostile service, but the serialized
Behavior Trees still depended on FindNearestPlayer.
Battle policy
Zone lookup ignored map identity; permissive zone rules
could remain active during Peace.
Civilian AI
Threat checks lacked director policy, unreachable shelters
were reserved repeatedly, and decorator index 1 crashed.
Death lifecycle
Pointer hashes plus sequence numbers could collide or be
reused, weakening exactly-once dispatch.
Validation
Several checks only searched source text; smoke flags did
not prove authoritative behavior or client replication.
fix
After: authoritative and fail-closed flow
Enemy targeting
Both Behavior Tree packages now reference the migrated
BTS_FindNearestHostile asset and native service.
Battle policy
MapId filters zones; only Conflict can enable configured
permissions. Other phases and unknown maps deny.
Civilian AI
Director snapshots govern threats; path reachability is
checked before reservation; fallback flees; index is 0.
Death lifecycle
FObjectKey identifies each victim and stores its highest
accepted sequence for deterministic duplicate rejection.
Validation
Native behavior assertions plus server probes verify phase,
deduplication, migrated asset loading, and client replication.
Verification evidence
AuraEditor Win64 Development: passed | RoleBattle automation: 107 passed, 0 failed (Days 10-12: 31)
Focused static contracts: passed | Day 10, Day 11, Day 12 listen-server probes: passed | git diff --check: clean
